messages.subject: Thanks!
messages.body_plain:
Today I spent the whole day trying to figure out how to get an R interface
to run on my mobile, because I want to do some work during a road trip but
can't take a bulky pc with me. I ended up installing RkWard through a
Debian environment app for android and was pleasantly surprised by its
smoothness. It runs as good as Rstudio does on my desktop. I feel really
glad to have come across it.

Kind regards.
Juan
